convectively coupled tropical waves are an important component of the tropical climate system.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the equatorial wave modes are not just passive waves in the tropics, they are actively involved in the dynamics of the atmosphere and are intimately linked with convection.
convectively coupled Kelvin and mixed Rossby gravity waves can be detected using a simple OLR dataset, and that the equivalent depths of the waves are shallower when coupled with convection.
